mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite a sustained rise in FEDFUNDS over the horizon, or the discount rate compression effect is not reflected in stock valuations.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden monthly increase in the CPIAUCSL index exceeding 1% triggers inflationary expectations, prompting central banks to raise interest rates, which reduces future stock valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when CPIAUCSL spikes above 1% in a month, or central banks do not adjust rates as expected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 4.5% indicates a tight labor market, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE falling below 4.5%, or earnings growth does not materialize as expected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO signals robust industrial production, reflecting stronger supply-side growth that enhances corporate earnings and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative despite a sustained rise in INDPRO, or supply-side growth does not translate to earnings gains.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDPC1 personal consumption expenditures signals strong demand, leading to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite GDPC1 rising, or demand does not translate to earnings growth.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and decline in UNRATE (tightening monetary policy and tight labor market) creates conflicting signals that suppress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when both FEDFUNDS rise and UNRATE fall, or the combined effect does not reduce valuations.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in FEDFUNDS rates signals potential rate cuts, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite FEDFUNDS falling in a late-cycle expansion, or rate cuts do not materialize as expected.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDPC1 (personal consumption) and RSAFS (industrial production demand) signals robust demand-side growth, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite both GDPC1 and RSAFS rising, or demand does not translate to earnings growth over the longer horizon.
